definitions.explanation: Moving backward while still facing forward, usually out of fear, surprise or caution.
Figuratively, hesitating or drawing back from something difficult or frightening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{後|あと}ずさり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{吠|ほ}えられて→吠える：02415_hoeru⟧{後|あと}ずさり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To back away when a dog barks at you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悲鳴|ひめい}→悲鳴：12621_himei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧あげて{後|あと}ずさり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The moment she saw the snake, she screamed and backed away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難題|なんだい}→難題：16722_nandai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{後|あと}ずさり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To shrink back from a hard problem.

examples.english: I balked when I heard the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{今|いま}さら{後|あと}ずさり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Now that I've decided, I can't back out at this point.

notes:
⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧ (back) + ずさり (from ずさる, to slide back). Also pronounced あとじさり, and written {後退|あとずさ}り.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{後|あと}ずさり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to step back without thinking
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧{後|あと}ずさり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a step back

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後退|こうたい}→後退：12556_koutai⟧: retreat, going backward, in a more formal or abstract sense
- ⟦{尻込|しりご}み→尻込み：12442_shirigomi⟧: hesitation, shrinking back, used mainly in the figurative sense
- ⟦たじろぐ→たじろぐ：07356_tajirogu⟧: to flinch, to falter
